item-size.$description: Minimum size of a numbered page control at standard density.

item-radius.$description: Corner radius of numbered page controls and direction links.

item-bg.$description: Resting background of a numbered page control.

item-fg.$description: Resting ink for page labels and status text.

item-hover-bg.$description: Background of a hovered page control.

item-hover-fg.$description: Ink for a hovered page control.

item-bg-image.$description: Optional image above the page control background color.

item-backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter for the page control.

current-bg.$description: Background of the current page control.

current-fg.$description: Ink for the current page control.

compact-gap.$description: Gap between the compact count and direction controls.

more-gap.$description: Gap between the load-more button and the count.
